title: FlowInOne: Unified Vision-Centric Multimodal Image Generation and Editing
summary: FlowInOne is a framework that unifies multimodal tasks like image generation and complex editing into a single continuous visual flow. It utilizes a Flow Matching architecture to treat text, layouts, and instructions as image-based visual prompts.
research_notes: The framework currently supports 256x256 resolution and was developed by researchers from CSU, NUS, Microsoft, and Tencent.

evolution.summary: The project launched in April 2026 with the VisPrompt-5M dataset and VP-Bench for evaluating visual instruction following. It establishes a vision-centric 'Image-In, Image-Out' paradigm that eliminates separate task-specific architectural branches.
